theme: Goal-based investing: education, retirement, home, wedding funds
headline: Build Your Future, One Goal at a Time
body: Define your goals first. Then choose investments matching your timeline and needs. Consistency transforms dreams into reality.
caption: Every major milestone needs a plan. Whether it's education, retirement, a home, or a wedding—starting early and staying invested helps you reach these goals. Your future self will thank you. #GoalBasedInvesting #WealthBuilding #InvestmentJourney #FutureReady #SmartSaving
